# Story 13.2: Execute the critical review and record file-referenced recommendations

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want the finished codebase reviewed against the plan from Story 13.1 with actionable recommendations written up,
So that I have a prioritized list of what to improve now that feature work is essentially complete.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Each aspect named in the Epic prose is reviewed against the codebase and produces concrete, file-referenced recommendations (not generic advice) recorded in that aspect's section of `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md`: Tailwind usage; readability/maintainability (naming conventions, code organization, clarity/terseness, best practices); consistency of coding style and conventions; error handling & logging; security implications & vulnerabilities; test coverage & quality; dependencies & third-party libraries usage; documentation & comments; opportunities for refactoring & optimization.
2. The finalized document at `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` contains the review plan (from Story 13.1) plus per-aspect recommendations, and no source file, RED/GREEN unit test, or e2e test is created or modified by this story.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1: Review each aspect; record file-referenced recommendations (AC: #1)
  - [ ] 1.1 Tailwind usage — flag inconsistent/ineffective class use and custom styles that should be minimized.
  - [ ] 1.2 Readability & maintainability — naming conventions, code organization, clarity/terseness, best-practice adherence; cite specific files/functions.
  - [ ] 1.3 Style consistency — inconsistencies in coding style/conventions across the four projects.
  - [ ] 1.4 Error handling & logging — gaps or inconsistent patterns (note: `no-console` is a hard lint rule here — recommend compliant logging, not raw `console.*`).
  - [ ] 1.5 Security implications & vulnerabilities — auth/cookie/CSP surface (AD-5), input validation, dependency risks.
  - [ ] 1.6 Test coverage & quality — weak or missing critical-path coverage; tie in with Epic 12's findings where relevant.
  - [ ] 1.7 Dependencies & third-party libraries — outdated/unused/redundant deps (deps are root-hoisted for `dms-material`).
  - [ ] 1.8 Documentation & comments — missing or stale docs/comments on critical paths.
  - [ ] 1.9 Refactoring & optimization opportunities — concrete, prioritized candidates with file references.
- [ ] Task 2: Finalize the document (AC: #2)
  - [ ] 2.1 Confirm `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` contains the review plan followed by per-aspect recommendations, each recommendation referencing the specific file(s)/path(s) it applies to; prioritize so Dave can act on the highest-value items first.
  - [ ] 2.2 Confirm no source file, unit test, or e2e test was created or modified — this Epic produces only the document.

## Dev Notes

- **This Epic is review-only.** Per the prose: "This epic does not require the standard set of RED/GREEN Unit tests nor the e2e tests." There is no TDD triple here — two stories that together produce one recommendations document. Do NOT add or modify any source/test code; only write `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md`.
- **Depends on Story 13.1:** the plan and per-aspect section headings already exist in `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` — fill them in place; do not restructure the document.
- **Recommendations must be concrete.** Each finding should name the file(s) and (where useful) line range, state the problem, and give a specific recommendation — not generic "improve readability" advice. Prioritize so Dave can act on the highest-value items first.
- **Consult the spines as reference:** ADs/FRs in `.github/workflow-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/**/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md` and `prds/**/prd.md` give intended design to compare actual code against — useful for the structure/pattern/security aspects.
- **Project-specific gotchas worth checking during review (verify current state before recommending):** Electron CSP inline-script handling in packaged builds, root-hoisted deps for `dms-material`, the `no-console` hard lint rule, and the shared e2e SQLite DB reuse behavior.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `/.github/epic-descriptions/epics-9999-99-99.md` (fill in Story 13.1's per-aspect sections with findings; no other file is created or modified).
- No source change, no test change — review-only by design.
- No conflict: purely additive content inside the document this Epic owns.
